== Biography ==
John Glasgow’s existing Kelso account records a baptism on 12 June 1768 and names David Glasgow and Janet Glasgow as his parents.<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-5947402/john-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms.</ref> The current mother-profile candidate is [[Hood-6028|Janet (Hood) Glasgow]], whose identity remains unassessed. The previous draft linked Janet to Glasgow-1219; retain that ID as superseded draft history, since it is not the current model mapping. A separate Kelso OPR transcript for a 12 June 1768 baptism names the child Jean and gives birth as 12 May. Whether that entry is John or a distinct Jean remains unresolved, so its birth date is not assigned to this John.<ref>Scotland’s Parish Births & Baptisms, Kelso OPR 793/3 item 1 p.98, SCOT/OPR/BAP/5055887 (https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F5055887&tab=this); original register image uninspected.</ref> His earlier approximate 1768 birth remains an estimate; the new Jean transcript does not establish John’s birthday.

John appears in the admission records of 8 October 1779 to a medical institution in Kelso, recommended by Mr. Charleton, at age 10, with a tumor on his face. He was cured by 17 October 1779.<ref>National Records of Scotland, NRS Reference HH71/7 p. 19.</ref>
